name: Guren no Shugo Tenshi Falna ~Injuu no Kokuin~
original_name: 紅蓮の守護天使ファルナ ～淫獣の刻印～
source:
Main character is a high class demon Asimov who is trying to conquer the world. Guren's guardian angel Fala fights day and night to prevent it. Fala must be turned into sex slave for the sake of a grander ambition.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是企图征服世界的高级恶魔阿西莫夫。红莲守护天使法尔娜日日夜夜与他作战，试图阻止其野心。为了实现更加宏大的目标，阿西莫夫必须把法尔娜变成性奴隶。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
